captions_note: the cards sit on the wall behind the speaker, so the reel's captions stay on. If cards reach the caption band, add that band to KEEP_OUT and run prep.py layout again
in_a_reel: set PUSH = 1 and BUMP = 1 (the slot must hand back unmoved footage at both edges)
set F_OUT at least 12 frames before the slot ends, unless the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
start the slot a few frames before F_START, so its first frame is plain footage
steps: run onsets.py      # 1. word onsets as frames -> fill HEADLINES, HEROES, F_* in build.py
run prep.py      # 2. track + matte + layout (about 1 to 2 min). LOOK at work/layout.jpg (and work/trackcheck.jpg if the camera moves). Set WALL / HERO_FIRST_SIDE if needed, then
run prep.py layout      # re-layout only (seconds). Repeat until the picture is right
run build.py SAFE=1 GRADE=0      # 3. page with the safe guide
run build.py GRADE=0      # 4. clean page (no guide), then render
